description: A PostHog self-managed data warehouse table: files in an S3-compatible bucket (CSV, Parquet, JSON or Delta) that PostHog reads as one table queryable with HogQL.

Credential.description: Access key for the bucket the files live in.

AccessKey.description: Access key ID for the bucket (an AWS access key ID, a Google Cloud HMAC key, or the equivalent for another S3-compatible store).

AccessSecret.description: Secret for the access key. Stored encrypted and never returned by the API.

CsvAllowDoubleQuotes.description: For CSV files that quote fields with doubled quotes.

ApiKey.description: PostHog personal API key (phx_...) with the scopes this resource type needs. Pass it with a dynamic reference such as {{resolve:ssm-secure:/posthog/api-key}} when calling SetTypeConfiguration; never put it in plain text.

BaseUrl.description: PostHog API host. Leave unset for PostHog Cloud US (https://us.posthog.com); use https://eu.posthog.com for PostHog Cloud EU, or your instance URL when self-hosting.

ProjectId.description: ID of the PostHog project the table belongs to.

Name.description: Name the table is queried by in HogQL. Must be unique within the project, start with a letter or underscore and contain only letters, numbers and underscores.

Format.description: File format of the objects the pattern matches. Every matched file must share this format.

UrlPattern.description: HTTPS URL of the files to read, with `*` matching any part of a path segment (e.g. https://your-bucket.s3.amazonaws.com/orders/*.parquet). All matched files are read as one table.

Credential.description: Bucket access key and secret. Write-only: never read back. Changing it sends the new credential to PostHog.

HogqlName.description: Dotted name the table is queried by in HogQL.
